html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 28, 2022

On Jul 21, 2022, MarTech SaaS Zhilian Engine (智链引擎) (founded 2021) closed a ¥2.5M angel for tech R&D and custom solutions. Two toolkits: analytics (Web→App node tracking, channel/behavior, loyalty cohorts) + matrix ops (high-quality user fission). Deep-linking stack: cross-channel attribution, deferred deep links (API, no SDK), 360° portraits, social fission without H5/invite codes, Web-to-App match rate >90% vs fingerprint matching. Underlying deep-link tech used by 100k+ apps globally (~80% of top-200), >85B link clicks/month. Parent Branch Metrics (Cayman) 100%.

— END —
